firstUseTour.celebrationAnnouncement: Your job-search journey starts now. Here’s to landing an offer you truly want!

welcome.title:
New to LuJie?
Start with the tutorial
welcome.description: LuJie guides you from a base resume through job matching, interview preparation, and application tracking to receiving an offer.

dashboard.title: The dashboard is your job-search overview
dashboard.description: Applications, upcoming actions, interviews, and offers appear here. An empty dashboard is normal at first and fills in as you use the workflow.

settings.title: Connect an AI provider first
settings.description: Choose a provider in Settings, enter your API key, save it, and test the connection. Your key is encrypted on this device and is never written into the project code.

resume.title: Prepare a base resume
resume.description: Import an existing resume or create one from scratch. Your original stays intact, while AI review and job matching create separate versions instead of overwriting it.

match.title: Tailor it to a specific JD
match.description: Choose a resume and paste the full job description. LuJie creates a tailored version, preserves the before-and-after content, and starts a job archive.

interview.title: Prepare for the same role
interview.description: Generate a structured preparation guide, practice with mock questions, and review the AI feedback. A tailored resume links these outcomes to its job first.

pipeline.title: Track your application progress
pipeline.description: Move roles through ready, applied, assessment, interview, and offer stages. Add dates and follow-ups so the dashboard can surface what needs attention.

library.title: Find every outcome in the career library
library.description: Browse complete job archives or view resumes, original JDs, and interview materials by type. You no longer need to search through each feature for past work.

careerLibrary.deleteArtifactConfirm: Delete “{name}”? Only this item will be deleted; other job materials will not be affected. This action cannot be undone.
careerLibrary.deleteArchiveConfirm:
Delete the job file “{name}”?

This permanently deletes:
• The original JD and job analysis
• {resumes} job-optimized resumes
• {preparations} interview preparation guides
• {interviews} mock interviews and reviews
• {applications} application tracking records

Your original resume will not be deleted. This action cannot be undone.

careerLibrary.deleteQuestionsConfirm: Delete all questions and answers from this mock interview? The AI review will be kept. This action cannot be undone.
careerLibrary.deleteFeedbackConfirm: Delete the AI review from this mock interview? The questions and answers will be kept. This action cannot be undone.
